children: Reliability launched a new wholly owned subsidiary, Reliability Workplace Solutions, to provide specialized Healthcare IT staffing and workforce services.
Announced launch of Reliability Workplace Solutions, a wholly owned workforce-services subsidiary.
Initial practice focuses on Healthcare IT staffing, including implementation, data, cybersecurity and infrastructure.
Services include staffing, employer-of-record, workforce administration, payroll support and compliance management.
John Pickeral will provide executive oversight; Ryan Hadley will lead the Healthcare IT practice.
Maslow Media Group will continue operating under its existing brand serving media and broadcast markets.
